Delivery is arranged by [Legal].

Lead time

Each mattress is made to order. A window agreed in advance. If we are going to miss that window we will tell you before the date, and you can cancel for a full refund.

Concierge unpacking

Included with every mattress. Concierged. Room of your choice. Unboxed, unrolled, positioned. The packaging leaves with it.

Old mattress removal and recycling

Collected on the same visit. Complimentary. Read what happens to it.

How dispatch is confirmed

You receive written confirmation with a delivery window. Cancel any time before dispatch for a full refund.
